data.name: Eternal Survivors
data.detailed_description:
Unlock 15 Chapters of 5 Heroes

Play through three-act journeys as Griffin, Hazel, Slaine, Gulzar, and Misato. Each hero has Chapters you unlock, which gives a unique skillset, a skin and a binds a new page to their swashbuckling story.

Combat for all your senses

Engage in fast-paced and butt clenching combat as relentless waves of enemies attack from all sides. Use quick movement, powerful abilities, and guile to stay alive.

Explore Strategic Battlegrounds

Fight across atmospheric zones from the Old Bog Road to the Cathedral of Tears. Each area includes unique events, mini-bosses, and a final, heroic showdown.

Level Up and Build Power

Gain loot, experience, and magical upgrades in every run. Stack them to evolve your hero and experiment with personalized builds for endless replayability.

Cultivate Your Power at Eterna’s Estate

Between battles, plant magical flowers and tend your personal sanctuary. These peaceful actions grant customizable passive buffs and long-term progression through base-building systems.

Mix Combat and Strategy

Plan your loadout. Experiment with game-breaking synergies between mid-run upgrades and permanent garden buffs.

Face the Final Test

At the end of it all stands the The Lady of Thirst and her dastardly deeds - a deadly final boss who tests everything you've learned. A climactic encounter like no other of its kind.

To My Cherished Subjects,

A glorious Solstice dawns upon our humble hamlet of Eterna!
My latest military campaign has produced an artefact of prosperity,
guaranteed to import a world-shattering new era of peace.
Come and be witness to this cosmic wonder at Eterna's cathedral this eve!
You won't want to miss it for the world*.

- The Lady of Thirst
* Participation is mandatory. Fowl play is forbidden.

data.short_description: In this swashbuckling survivor-lite, face relentless hordes and ultimate bosses. Embark on a 3-act journey with 5 intrepid heroes. Harvest P.L.A.N.T power and shatter game designers’ dreams of balance with game-breaking builds.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100T @ 2.5GHz or AMD equivalent (dual-core)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7850 or equivalent (DirectX 11 compatible with 2GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
